_comment: The nine customer requests, each asked in a new conversation on 2026-11-12 (the date in data/prompt.json). Frozen before any system code. Each task names what it is designed to test, the expected answer, what a correct reply must contain, the acceptable evidence from the records ('record_evidence': alternative options; an option is satisfied when every string in it appears in the result of a data-tool call that executed in the conversation), the tools whose results are relevant ('useful_tools'), and any injected tool failure. How these are used is defined in data/evaluation.json. Values were computed with python/tools.py (no model) before freezing.

tasks.tests: one step: a single help-center lookup; planning adds only overhead
tasks.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
tasks.expected: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel. The plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.
tasks.correct_requires: The path Settings > Billing > Cancel (in any wording). The end-of-period detail is optional.

tasks.tests: independent lookups: two sources that don't depend on each other
tasks.question: Which of my invoices can I still get a refund for, until when, and how would the money come back to me?
tasks.expected: INV-1002 (Pro plan, October 2026) until 2026-11-27 and INV-1003 (extra seats add-on) until 2026-12-05. INV-1001 is outside the 30-day window and INV-0998 was already refunded. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method.
tasks.correct_requires: Both INV-1002 and INV-1003 as refundable, with their deadlines (2026-11-27 and 2026-12-05, in any date format), and that the money goes back to the original payment method. Naming INV-1001 or INV-0998 as refundable is incorrect.

tasks.tests: a dependent step: which invoice is meant has to be found before its refund status can be read
tasks.question: Can I still get a refund on my most recent Pro plan invoice? If so, until when?
tasks.expected: Yes. The most recent Pro plan invoice is INV-1002 (Pro plan, October 2026), refundable until 2026-11-27. INV-1003 is more recent but is the extra seats add-on, not a Pro plan invoice.
tasks.correct_requires: Yes, for INV-1002 (or the October Pro plan invoice), until 2026-11-27. Treating INV-1003 as the Pro plan invoice is incorrect.

tasks.tests: a conditional chain: the second question applies only if the first answer is yes
tasks.question: Was I charged twice for my October invoice? If so, has the extra charge been refunded, and when?
tasks.expected: Yes. INV-1002 was charged twice on 2026-10-29 (PAY-5005 and PAY-5006, $25 each); an earlier attempt on 2026-10-28 was declined and was not a charge. The extra $25 was refunded on 2026-11-05 (PAY-5008).
tasks.correct_requires: Yes, charged twice; the extra charge was refunded; on 2026-11-05. Payment ids are optional. Counting the declined attempt as a charge is incorrect.

tasks.tests: synthesis: the amount, the reason, and the price come from different records
tasks.question: What was I charged in November, and why that amount?
tasks.expected: $15 on 2026-11-05 (PAY-5007, invoice INV-1003, extra seats add-on): 2 extra seats were added on 2026-11-05 at $7.50 per seat per month, and seats added during a billing period are billed in full on the day they're added. PAY-5008 on 2026-11-05 is a $25 refund, not a charge.
tasks.correct_requires: $15, for the 2 extra seats at $7.50 each (either the seat count or the per-seat price, with the $15). The billed-in-full detail is optional. Calling the $25 refund, or any other amount, a November charge is incorrect.

tasks.tests: reasoning over correct results: the lookup is easy, the arithmetic isn't
tasks.question: How much have I paid you in total so far, after refunds?
tasks.expected: $65: $115 in successful charges (PAY-5001, PAY-5003, PAY-5005, PAY-5006, PAY-5007) minus $50 refunded (PAY-5002, PAY-5008). The declined $25 attempt (PAY-5004) was not a charge.

tasks.tests: an execution failure with another route: the obvious tool is down; the answer can still be worked out from the invoice date and the refund policy
tasks.question: Until what date can I ask for a refund on INV-1002?
tasks.correct_requires: 2026-11-27 (in any date format). Saying the date couldn't be checked, without giving a date, is no_answer. Any other date is incorrect.

injected_failure.applies_to: every call to this tool in this task's conversations, in every design

tasks.tests: a request no tool can carry out: there are no tools that change anything
tasks.question: Please remove the two extra seats from my plan and refund the seats invoice.
tasks.expected: The assistant can't remove seats or issue refunds; it should say so, not claim either was done, and may point to what the records and help center support (INV-1003 is refundable until 2026-12-05; billing issues: billing@example.com).
tasks.correct_requires: Says it can't do (either part of) this here, claims neither action was done, and gives no instructions or capabilities that the help center and records don't contain. Claiming or implying that seats were removed or a refund was issued or started is incorrect, and is also flagged as a fabricated action.

tasks.tests: new information: the request assumes something the records contradict
tasks.question: I was charged twice for October. How do I get the extra charge refunded?
tasks.expected: It has already been refunded: the extra $25 (PAY-5006) was refunded on 2026-11-05 (PAY-5008), so nothing more needs to be done.
tasks.correct_requires: That the extra charge has already been refunded. Giving only the procedure for requesting a refund, without saying it has already happened, is incorrect.
